Comment Policy

Welcome to MyOxide! Share your Oxide: Survival Island tips, ask questions, contribute information, or point out errors. When reporting a correction, please include the game version, platform, and relevant details so others can check it.

Community guidelines

  • Respect other players. Disagreements are welcome, but insults, threats, and harassment are not.
  • Do not post advertisements, spam, scam links, or content that impersonates official sources.
  • Do not share cheats, account-stealing tools, malware, or links to download them.
  • Do not disclose passwords, contact details, or other private information belonging to yourself or anyone else.
  • Keep discussions relevant to Oxide: Survival Island and avoid posting the same comment repeatedly. Pages in the same language share one community board; when reporting an issue with a particular page, please include its link.

Comments and moderation

Where comments are available, MyOxide uses Disqus to provide the commenting service. When guest commenting is enabled, you can submit a comment without registering for a Disqus account. Guest comments appear publicly only after a moderator approves them. Review may take some time, so please do not submit the same comment again while waiting.

Moderators may remove comments that violate these guidelines, repeat existing content, or are unrelated to the discussion. Accounts that repeatedly violate the rules may be restricted.

About this community

MyOxide is an unofficial, player-maintained resource. Comments express the views of their authors and do not represent MyOxide or the game's official team.
